question: Who wins the Alaska Senate race in 2026
quote: So I think Dan Sullivan, the real Dan Sullivan, the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan ekes it out. But this wouldn't stun me if it went the other way, unfortunately.
turn_text: So I think if you asked me a week ago, I would have said Peltola, the Democrat. I'm going to go with Dan Sullivan. And I mean the real Dan Sullivan. This is not me covering my bases by saying that 50% of the candidates who qualified are Dan Sullivans. I think the New York Times – by the way, we should point out our Camden Mulder had a lot of that story before the New York Times did. But it's not real if it happens in National Review. It's only real to Democrats if it happens in the New York Times. The New York Times story I think hurts. I think it makes Peltola look dirty. I think it makes the Alaska Democrats look shady. And I just think the Laskans – it's one thing to beat somebody on the merits or on his record. But when you try to do this kind of underhanded tricks and stuff like that, I think it looks badly on them. So I think Dan Sullivan, the real Dan Sullivan, the Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan ekes it out. But this wouldn't stun me if it went the other way, unfortunately.
host_quote: But Jim Garrity, we have a nip and tuck race in Alaska where there's some last-minute drama. Who's going to win?
resolution_criteria: The candidate who wins the 2026 Alaska US Senate general election, after ranked-choice tabulation if no candidate has a first-round majority. Decided by the Associated Press's call. If AP has not called it within 60 days of election day, the certified official result decides. Resolves when the race is called.
